result.brief: 提出免训练的长度选择器 Entropy-Valley，用全掩码前向的预测熵为掩码扩散机器翻译挑选目标画布长度。
result.reason: Masked diffusion decoding for machine translation; no video/multimodal world model, visual representation, or continuous language latent contribution. Length selection is decoding strategy, not continuous language modeling.
